why: Tests fix round for ticket 1062 slice 1 (decision 0568, docs/plan/quests/error-cause-PLAN.md), in next/, after review 1 sent L4 back for two classes. One: the two L4 files wrote `_tag` by hand in their encoded values (0562); each value is now made with the error's class and encoded by the old optionalKey schema, then given its cause, so no `_tag` is written in either file. Two: L4's generator never drew an Error-shaped cause, the one case where Schema.Defect() and Schema.Unknown differ; both files now draw a fourth cause form, an Error with a drawn name and message encoded by Schema.Defect(), assert it decodes to an Error, and count it in the coverage check, so a run that never reaches it fails. Case counts now use runsFor({ fast: 50, full: 200 }). Both L4 laws are green on the built branch; each of the six plants below turns its law red. The reviewer's finding row is written as field/findings/2026-11-15-error-cause-plan-prose-counts.json, rebuilt from the review row and the tests1 row's note, since the review row holds no finding JSON.
